title: Maximum Distance Between a Pair of Values
goal: Maximize j-i subject to i <= j and nums1[i] <= nums2[j].
strategy: Both arrays are nonincreasing. A valid pair can extend its right index; an invalid value comparison must advance the left index because later right values cannot be larger.
